comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Electronic instruments, motors and test equipment; shares sensors and motion parts with ITT but is a different core business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Asphalt plants, aggregate and mining crushers serve road builders, a different business from ITT's pumps, valves and friction products.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Makes industrial valves, pumps, aerospace components and sensors for process plants and aerospace OEMs, closely matching ITT's offering.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Distributes MRO pumps and valves and provides repair services; it is a distributor rather than a manufacturer like ITT.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Welding and cutting consumables and equipment serve fabricators; no overlap with ITT's pumps, valves or friction products.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Core businesses are utility smart meters, power test equipment and filtration; aerospace valves are only a minor line.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Designs and services pumps, valves and seals for oil, gas, chemical and power plants, closely matching ITT's Industrial Process business.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Papermaking and wood processing machinery for mills; fluid handling is a minor line and customers differ from ITT's.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Electrical switchgear and substations are electrical power equipment, not pumps, valves or friction components.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Designs emissions-certified engines and generator sets for equipment makers, a different product from ITT's pumps and valves.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Sells specialty chemical fluids, lubricants and coatings; a consumable chemistry business unlike ITT's engineered components.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Makes locks, hinges, security hardware and metal castings; no pumps, valves or friction products.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Designs and manufactures industrial, petroleum and water pumps and pump systems, overlapping ITT's pump business and end markets.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Industrial process heat tracing and heating systems; serves plant operators but its products are not pumps, valves or friction parts.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Product coding printers and water quality instruments serve food and utilities; different products from ITT's engineered components.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Commercial plumbing fixtures, drinking water coolers and filters for buildings; valves are minor and customers are building-focused.
